input.job: Add new leads from the user's inbox as HubSpot contacts

guide.job: Add new leads from the user's inbox as HubSpot contacts
guide.summary: To allow your users to connect their HubSpot accounts to your AI agent for creating contacts, you can register your own HubSpot application, implement OAuth 2.0 authorization, store and refresh tokens, and call the HubSpot API.

verdict.difficulty_reason: A required review, verification, assessment, or installation cap applies to public launches and third-party app installations.

composio.note: Composio has a HubSpot toolkit with 323 actions; Composio can handle the sign-in for you.

route.name: Direct OAuth App
route.reason: You register your own HubSpot app, handle sign-in, and store tokens yourself.

paths.name: Use Composio managed OAuth
paths.when_to_choose: Fastest setup without registering your own app in HubSpot.
paths.tradeoffs: Users see an unverified app warning until the default app clears review.

paths.name: Direct OAuth App
paths.when_to_choose: When you want your own branding and control over scopes.
paths.tradeoffs: Requires managing client credentials, redirect URIs, token refreshing, and public app review for limits above 25 installs.

paths.name: HubSpot Private App / Personal Access Token
paths.when_to_choose: For single-user local prototyping where OAuth is unnecessary.
paths.tradeoffs: Cannot scale to other users connecting their own accounts.

prerequisites.how_to_get: Sign up for a free developer account through HubSpot's website.

needs.ok_if: A personal site or your app's temporary testing URL works for testing
needs.later: A real website and privacy policy become required for a public app

actions: Go to HubSpot developer portal and click **Sign up**
Complete the CRM onboarding questionnaire providing a website
prerequisites.done_when: You can access the HubSpot developer dashboard

friction_checks.answer: Yes, HubSpot's developer sign-up goes through free CRM onboarding asking for a website.
Privately distributed apps are capped at 10 portals; Marketplace apps are capped at 25 installs until listed.

steps.title: Create a HubSpot app
actions: Go to your developer account and click **Apps**
Click **Create app** and configure basic information
steps.detail: Establish your app entity within HubSpot to generate client credentials and configure OAuth settings.
steps.done_when: App is created and client ID/secret are generated

steps.title: Configure OAuth redirect URI
actions: Navigate to the **Auth** tab in your app settings
Enter your callback URL and click **Save**
steps.detail: Set up the redirect endpoint where HubSpot will send authorization codes after a user grants permission.

steps.title: Select contact scopes
steps.detail: Ensure your app requests the necessary permissions to read and write contacts on behalf of connecting users.
steps.done_when: Scopes are configured for the app

steps.title: Implement OAuth code in agent
actions: Write authorization redirect logic pointing to https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize
Implement token exchange handling via POST to https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v1/token
steps.detail: Build the agent backend to handle the OAuth authorization handshake, securely store tokens, and refresh them automatically.
steps.agent_prompt: Implement an OAuth 2.0 flow for HubSpot, handling authorization code redirection, exchanging codes for access and refresh tokens at https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v1/token, and securely storing them.
steps.done_when: Token exchange code is written and integrated

steps.title: Submit app for marketplace review
actions: Complete app review requirements in the developer portal
Submit app for marketplace listing review
steps.detail: Submit your app to lift the 25-install marketplace limit and the 10-portal private distribution limit for public launch.

steps.title: Wait for marketplace approval
actions: Monitor review status in the developer portal
steps.detail: Wait for HubSpot security and compliance team to review and approve the public application.

steps.title: Test end-to-end contact creation
actions: Trigger the agent to ingest a mock inbox lead
Verify the contact appears in HubSpot CRM
steps.detail: Execute a full test to verify that user sign-in, token storage, and contact creation execute successfully.
steps.agent_prompt: Write a test script that uses a valid HubSpot OAuth token to call the CRM contacts API and create a new test contact.
steps.done_when: Test contact is successfully added via agent execution

steps.title: Make your agent do the job
actions: Copy the prompt below into your coding agent.
Run it once with your own account.
steps.detail: This is the point of the prototype: your agent using the connection.
steps.done_when: Your agent completed the job in HubSpot for your own account.
steps.agent_prompt: First check the connect step really happened: the HubSpot tool exists and is registered with my agent.  If anything is missing, stop and tell me what. Otherwise run my agent once on this job with my own account: Add new leads from the user's inbox as HubSpot contacts. Show me what changed in HubSpot.

glossary.plain: The URL where the provider sends users after they approve or deny access to your application.

scopes.why: Required to create and update contact records in HubSpot CRM from inbox leads.

approval.process: Marketplace review and security assessment triggered when scaling past installation caps.

blockers.mitigation: Submit app for marketplace review before scaling past 10 private portals or 25 public installs.

alternatives: Use HubSpot private app token for single-user testing
agent_can_do: Call API endpoints to create contacts
you_must_do: Sign up for a developer account
Create a HubSpot app and configure redirect URIs
guide.next_action: Sign up for a HubSpot developer account and create your app configuration.
open_questions: Exact turnaround time for marketplace review queue variants

decisions.title: Who will connect their account?
decisions.why_it_matters: Other people signing in can mean an approval wait.

options.label: My users
options.what_it_means: Other people connect their own accounts to your agent.
options.recommended_reason: You're building for other people, so the guide covers what it takes to launch.

options.label: Just me
options.what_it_means: Only your own account, to try the idea first.

decisions.title: How will your agent connect to this app?
decisions.why_it_matters: Choose how your agent signs in and manages HubSpot access for users.

options.label: Use Composio
options.what_it_means: Composio hosts the sign-in, manages tokens, and gives ready-made HubSpot actions.
options.recommended_reason: Composio provides instant access to HubSpot with managed sign-in and pre-built actions, saving weeks of OAuth setup.

options.label: Direct OAuth App
options.what_it_means: You register your own HubSpot app, handle sign-in, and store tokens yourself.
options.recommended_reason: Requires building custom OAuth and token management from scratch.

decisions.title: Whose name should users see at sign-in?
decisions.why_it_matters: Your own name means your own approval.

options.label: Composio's name
options.what_it_means: Users sign in through Composio's HubSpot app, already approved.
options.recommended_reason: It skips registering and reviewing your own app. You can switch to your own later.

options.label: Your own app
options.what_it_means: Register your own HubSpot app and plug it into Composio.

library.challenge: Developer account and test accounts; marketplace listing only to be listed publicly.
